teaser: A half-deflated balloon sags over the folding table, and you are the one refilling the juice cups before anyone asks — life path 6, filtered through INFP, already at work. The six asks for a life spent tending — home, family, the people who drift into your orbit and stay; INFP brings a quieter version of the same instinct, not duty exactly, but a conviction that love, done right, is a kind of art. Cross the two and the tending stops being chore and starts being devotion, sometimes more than the room can hold.
